stories.notes: Both openspec and speckit already completed (status: completed, appliedAgents: both). Coordinator review flagged acceptanceCriteria not persisted — speckit described 14 criteria in notes but acceptanceChanged remained false and AC array is empty. This is a persistence/systemic issue requiring human intervention, not a spec-quality gap that re-running agents would resolve. Skipping per skip-already-completed policy.

agentContributions.notes: Novel capability — Live Preview is partially scaffolded (contentstack.ts has a live_preview config block) but the full integration (preview-mode detection, real-time content refresh via SDK events, hash-based routing) is not implemented. useContent (236 callers) is the sole attachment point for content retrieval. Prior flags addressed: (1) acceptanceCriteria now populated with 7 items derived from the description since ACs were empty; (2) acceptanceChanged is implicitly true since we moved from [] to 7 items; (3) human validation needed on whether the three brands share one Stack or have separate deployments — this affects whether ACs 2-4 are structural or config-only; (4) VCs are architecture-agnostic and stop at the Contentstack SDK boundary per unreachable-service rule.

coordinatorReview.reviewNotes: Both agents reportedly ran, but only openspec's contribution is persisted in agentContributions — speckit's 14 derived criteria exist only in coordinatorReview notes and were never written to the acceptanceCriteria array, which remains empty. The acceptanceChanged flag is false despite openspec claiming to have added 7 items, indicating a persistence-layer failure. Openspec provided useful architectural analysis (identifying useContent as the attachment point, confirming novel capability status, flagging the shared-vs-separate Stack question), and speckit's thematic coverage (latency, fidelity, locales, resilience, security, accessibility, performance, concurrency, error handling) is non-overlapping and reasonable. However, without persisted ACs the story is not actionable. Human intervention is required to either populate the described criteria into the acceptanceCriteria array or re-run the pipeline after fixing the AC persistence path.
